description: This source file defines the CounterCaptureCommand class, which is a command-line command for capturing and reporting counters in an Orleans distributed system. It includes options for identifiers, URIs, and counters, and performs asynchronous operations to connect to a cluster, retrieve counter data, and log metrics.

classes.name: CounterCaptureCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for capturing counters from an Orleans cluster, with logic to connect, wait, gather counters, measure, and log the results.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: A nested class encapsulating the parameters for the command such as ServiceId, ClusterId, URIs, CounterKey, and Counters list.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked when the command is executed. It connects to the Orleans cluster, retrieves counter data, measures, and logs counters, and then stops the host.
